5319624.sourceDescription: Make space for festive magic without sacrificing floor space. This 6ft pencil tree brings the Christmas spirit to smaller rooms with a slimline design that tucks neatly into corners and compact spaces. It's pre-lit with 100 warm white bulbs and finished with a light dusting of snow, creating that cosy glow without the decorating fuss. wgvt8hhm.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
wgvt8hhm.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
wgvt8hhm.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree offers a modern seasonal décor solution for any occasion. Its elegant cone shape and versatile green color seamlessly fit into living rooms, gardens, or terraces, providing an eye-catching focal point without overwhelming the setting. Ideal for those who appreciate contemporary style, this thoughtfully designed product ensures ease of setup with its built-in LED lighting, enhancing its decorative appeal. PVC and Steel Construction Engineered with premium PVC, the tree provides a lightweight yet stable structure that withstands the test of time. The steel components augment the tree's sturdiness, ensuring it remains upright, thus facilitating safe and enjoyable decorating sessions. These materials enhance resilience, promising extended use, season after season, with minimal upkeep required. Integrated LED Lights Enjoy the glow of warm white LED lighting that enriches your atmosphere and resonates with the festive spirit. The energy-efficient LED string lights are artfully distributed across the tree, illuminating every branch and providing a radiant charm that is both subtle and captivating without consuming unnecessary power. USB Power Source Equipped with a USB power connector, this tree provides a convenient and modern way to illuminate your festive ambiance. Plug it into any certified 5V USB power source to instantly bless your space with joyful light. This feature enhances portability, allowing easy placement wherever you desire festive illumination. Decorative Convenience Designed for those who relish aesthetic yet functional designs, this tree celebrates the modern minimalistic style. Its ornamental nature infuses spaces with style and warmth, while also offering practical USB compatibility for a simple power connection, which elevates the overall user experience with its ease of use. Dual-Use Design Perfectly poised for both indoor and outdoor settings, this tree adapts effortlessly to different environments, whether it’s a cozy living room retreat or a holiday-themed terrace. Its flexible design allows for imaginative placement and creative decoration solutions, enhancing spaces with festive cheer and contemporary grace. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC and metal Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 90 cm Stand size: 40 x 40 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips with iridescent decorations Reusable, Low maintenance, Simple setup, Sturdy metal stand 8 Lighting modes: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on Number of PVC tips: 564 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: Plug Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

kbvzdn41.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit And Decorated Flocked Pop-Up Christmas Tree
kbvzdn41.sourceDescription: Create an impressive, beautifully finished Christmas display without spending hours assembling, lighting and decorating your tree. The 7ft Pre-lit & Decorated Flocked Pop-up Tree combines snowy foliage, warm white lights and traditional decorations in one clever, easy-to-use design. The rich green foliage is covered with a generous layer of snow-effect flocking, creating the appearance of a freshly snow-covered Christmas tree. It's already decorated with a coordinated selection of red and white baubles and traditional tartan bows, giving you a classic festive look straight out of the box. With 200 warm white LED lights already arranged throughout the foliage, the tree produces a soft and welcoming Christmas glow. The LEDs are static and remain steadily illuminated, beautifully complementing the traditional decorations and snowy finish. Its clever pop-up construction makes setting up your Christmas display quick and straightforward, while the slim 75cm maximum width gives you the impressive height of a 7ft Christmas tree without requiring the floor space of a conventional full-width design. 9nn8vb8p.sourceDescription: This Contemporary Metal Christmas Tree embodies the fusion of modern design aesthetics and traditional holiday spirit. Its sleek metal structure brings an unconventional chic to any living space, garden, or terrace, offering a refreshing alternative to traditional evergreen trees. Standing tall, it is an eye-catching centerpiece that captivates attention and adds a unique festive charm to your home. Materials: The tree is constructed from powder-coated steel, known for its abrasion resistance, which ensures longevity and maintains the tree's aesthetic appeal over the years. This material choice provides the tree with robustness, capable of withstanding the hustle and bustle of the festive arrangements without compromising its design. The powder coating also gives the tree a non-reflective, matte finish that blends seamlessly with any contemporary decor theme. Included Components: Delivered as 1 x Metal Christmas tree, the tree includes a sturdy steel stand for reliable support. Its construction ensures it holds firmly in place whether adorning your living room or the terrace. This essential component allows the tree to remain upright, providing a stable base that invites creativity in decorating with your favorite ornaments and lights. Features /Function /Design: With a contemporary design, this tree stands out as a striking holiday decoration. Its non-traditional form encourages versatility in holiday layouts, allowing users to integrate it into various interior styles, from minimalistic to modern chic. The tree’s design is characterized by a sleek, streamlined look, making it an appealing accent piece year-round. Recommended Uses: Perfect for indoor and sheltered outdoor use, the tree can beautify living rooms, gardens, and terraces. It serves not only as a Christmas tree but transforms these spaces into festive retreats, allowing homeowners to express their modern style and creativity during the holiday season. Care &Maintenance: Assembly requires only one person and a screwdriver, following the manufacturer's instructions. This simplified process ensures that homeowners can set up the tree effortlessly. When not in use, disassemble with care to maintain its structural integrity and store it to protect the finish for future holidays.
